newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends lower on dollar/yen fluctuation.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends lower on dollar/yen fluctuation.

text.p: The won weakened against the dollar in narrow trading on Wednesday as the greenback rebounded against the yen in world markets.
The dollar firmed around 113.60 yen late on Wednesday in Tokyo after another day of volatile trading.

The won finished at 891.00, compared with Tuesday's close of 890.60. After opening at 891.00, the won fell to a low of 891.40 on dollar short-covering stemming from the dollar's strength against the yen around the 114.20 level.
But the won peaked at 890.60 on a yen rebound following a comment from a Bank of Japan official that central bank was considering the timing to raise its official discount rate.
The Bank of Japan later said no immediate rate rise was planned.
Dealers said fears of central bank intervention prevented the won/dollar market from fluctuating widely. They forecast a similar trading pattern for the time being.
But they said wide fluctuations in world markets after the release on Wednesday of U.S. trade figures would affect the local market.
Thursday's mid-rate is forecast to be pegged at 890.90 against 890.60 today. Dealers estimated Wednesday's trading volume at $940 million.
